app.name: SocialPrune
scan.title: Model suggestions
scan.intro: Use your own model endpoint to suggest what to review. Only you decide what stays or goes.
scan.batchHelp: Choose 1 to 50. No batch size has been measured for your model yet.
scan.checkHelp: Check sends one invented entry and preset criteria, never entries from your workspace.
scan.share.local: Your entries' text and your criteria go to {origin}, a program on this computer, for the model {model}. SocialPrune cannot see where that program sends them. If it passes them to a service on the internet, they leave your computer and can count against your plan or cost money there.
scan.share.remote: Your entries' text and your criteria leave your computer for {origin}, for the model {model}. That service handles them under its own terms and can charge your account. SocialPrune cannot see or limit what happens to them there.
scan.terms: The terms of the service behind {origin} apply to what you send there, and so do the terms of X and Instagram. SocialPrune does not check them for you.
scan.key: Key file: {path}. SocialPrune reads a key only from this file.
scan.agree: I want to send my entries there
scan.contents: Each entry carries its platform, kind and full text, with criterion definitions. No originals, engagement or keep rules are sent.
scan.plan: {planned, number} entries left to check, {skipped, number} already checked by this source. {uniqueTexts, number} unique texts, about {requests, number} first-pass requests. {alreadyDecided, number} already have your decision and are included.
scan.canary: The first run stops after at most 50 entries. Read their suggestions in Review before continuing with the rest.
scan.progress: {stored, number} of {planned, number} suggestions stored. {remaining, number} entries left in this run.
scan.requests: {requests, number} requests, {retries, number} retries, {secondPassEntries, number} entries in a second pass. Batch size {batchSize, number}.
scan.tokens: Tokens reported by the endpoint: input {input}, cached {cached}, output {output}.
scan.reviewed: I have reviewed the first suggestions and want to continue
scan.phase.idle: Set up and check your endpoint before sending entries.
scan.phase.paused: Paused. No new request starts until you resume.
scan.pausePending: Pause requested. Open requests finish first.
reviewFeed.sourceLater: Choose a suggestion source after setting your criteria. This screen does not run a model.
reviewFeed.planSaved: Marked. Nothing was deleted on the platform.
reviewFeed.helpBody: Focus a post to use these keys. Page Up and Page Down move between posts, Home goes to the first and End to the last. Ctrl+Z or Command+Z undoes the last action. Turn single-letter keys off in Settings.
reviewFeed.definition.toxic: Hostile language not aimed at a person or group.
reviewFeed.definition.personal-attack: Insults, belittles or threatens a particular person.
reviewFeed.definition.political: Expresses a political position or partisan argument.
reviewFeed.definition.sexual: Explicit sexual content or sexual remarks.
reviewFeed.definition.drugs-illegal: Promotes or describes personal involvement with drugs or illegal activity.
reviewFeed.definition.personal-info: Reveals private contact, identity or location information.
reviewFeed.definition.embarrassing: A disclosure or remark you may prefer not to present today.
reviewFeed.definition.empty: Filler or a reaction without meaningful context.
reviewFeed.definition.racist: Puts people down for their origin or skin colour.
reviewFeed.definition.misogynistic: Puts women down for being women.
reviewFeed.definition.group-hostility: Puts people down for religion, sexuality, gender identity, disability or age.
reviewFeed.definition.politically-incorr: Remarks about groups that many find demeaning today, without open hostility.

keepRules.title: Your rules
keepRules.intro: SocialPrune checks them against the numbers in your export. No model and no agent reads them.

keepRules.reposts: Never delete with this many reposts or more

keepRules.instagram: Reposts and Instagram comments have no own like or repost count here. These number rules never hold them back.

start.privacy: SocialPrune reads your export in this browser. It has no server that could receive it.
gate.unavailable.title: This window cannot open real exports
gate.unavailable.body: SocialPrune opens an export only when it can block network access for the code that reads it, and this window does not allow that. Some private windows do this. Open SocialPrune in a normal window, or use the command line version. The demo works here.
gate.framed.title: Open SocialPrune directly
gate.framed.body: SocialPrune opens exports only when it is not embedded in another page. Open socialprune.github.io/socialprune directly.

clicklist.noticeInstagram: SocialPrune does nothing on Instagram. You find and delete each comment yourself. The list only records your result.

desktop.updates.direct: Open the GitHub releases page in your browser to see versions, download files and SHA-256 values. The app does not check automatically.
desktop.updates.store: The Microsoft Store updates this app. Check for updates in the Store.

desktop.warning.full: X and Instagram do not allow automated use of their websites. They can limit, lock or suspend your account for it, and SocialPrune cannot predict whether they will. SocialPrune does not hide that a program drives the browser. It works only in the browser window next to this one, only on entries you marked yourself, starts with one entry you watch, waits between steps and stops at the first error. In the dedicated profile it can change the following:
